name: Fermented-fish hotpot
summary: The national rural article names lẩu mắm on the Cồn Phụng lunch and prints no recipe. The provincial tourism portal, 9 June 2021, describes a town pot from pork bone and fermented cá linh, filled with basa, goby, pork belly, shrimp, squid, beef balls, eggplant, and bitter melon. A price is check on arrival.
origin: On the Cồn Phụng lunch list, and in town on the provincial tourism portal.
howToEat: At Cồn Phụng it is a shared lunch pot. The rural article stops at the name.
The 9 June 2021 article sets the town pot with rau tai tượng, water lily, banana blossom, and water spinach. It does not print a price. The price is check on arrival.
where: The garden table at Cồn Phụng. The 9 June 2021 article describes a town pot and does not print a street.
